back.target: to turn, to rotate (also to shoot a film)
back.example: Turn the key to the left.

note: The hint "rotate, twist" is needed, because it rules out abbiegen (turning at a corner) and wenden/umdrehen (turning around); the Spanish cards vuelta-turn (a noun), cumplir-turn-age and convertir-turn-into all have other meanings, so null is right.
